concept: Engaging with civic processes (voting, local government, community boards) as a real responsibility, not an abstraction
source_inspiration: original content, informed by Cicero's civic-duty tradition — not sourced from any external text

exercise.case_study: A realistic scenario where a local decision (school board, zoning, community funding) will affect the adult's own neighborhood
exercise.reflection_prompt: What does genuine civic engagement look like here, beyond just having an opinion?
exercise.practice: Adult identifies one concrete way to actually engage with the process, not just discuss it

assessment.success_marker: adult names a specific, real action (attending a meeting, voting, submitting comment) rather than a vague intention
